limitations: Shared Engine native checks use invocation-local ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 for the known ptrace/LeakSanitizer runner limitation; ASan/UBSan remain enabled, leak checking is unverified.
Standalone CPU Debug is unsanitized. Full static Engine, non-Linux/other-toolchain ABI and installed SDK acceptance remain unverified.
Full canonical witnesses can cost 8 MiB and depend on current codec behavior; there is no compact/stable cross-version digest or persisted patch/recipe format.
Borrowed witness views expire on destruction/move/assignment; public C++ values/exceptions require compatible ABI. Allocation exceptions propagate by unchanged source inspection, without OOM testing.
File guarantees remain the Linux caller-controlled single-writer profile without fsync/durability, hostile-directory race, network-filesystem or multiwriter acceptance.
